verdict.rationale: Letta exposes a narrow trigger mechanism — 'dreaming' can be configured to run after N steps, on context compaction, or never — which is a genuine automatic event-based trigger, and headless/CLI mode supports scripting/CI integration for external automation. However, there's no evidence of a general-purpose rule/event system letting users define arbitrary triggers-to-actions (e.g., on message received, on file change, on schedule) beyond this memory-consolidation trigger. Missing for 10: general event-trigger API/rules engine, support for arbitrary custom triggers/actions, and independent confirmation of automation-depth beyond the dreaming feature.
